theme: Theme it around his favorite dump trucks and excavators at the construction work site.

draws.label: letter-spotter/name_it control #1
draws.title: Alex's Beginning Letters Spotter
targets: s ← sun: The sun is hot today.
a ← ant: An ant crawls on the rug.
t ← top: Pat has a red top.
i ← ink: Ink spills on the desk.
p ← Pip: Pip likes to hop fast.
n ← Nan: Nan naps on the bed.
